name: AVA 数据分析
description: Analyze local files, direct databases, inline data and Feishu Bitable with AVA. Verify metrics and create charts and reports.
description_zh: 分析本地文件、直连数据库、内联数据和飞书多维表格，核对指标，生成图表和报告。
description_en: Analyze local files, direct databases, inline data and Feishu Bitable with AVA. Verify metrics and create charts and reports.
examples_zh: 分析我上传的 CSV，核对收入变化
连接数据库，找出收入变化最大的产品
核对各产品变化之和，并生成图表
examples_en: Analyze my CSV and verify revenue changes
Connect my database and find the largest product changes
Reconcile product contributions and create a chart
